bindSchema(bytes32).details: Permissionless and one-shot on purpose. The schema UID commits to this resolver's own      address (`keccak256(schema, resolver, revocable)`), so the caller cannot choose a UID      that belongs to anyone else's instance — there is nothing here worth gating, and an      owner would be one more thing to lose. Until it is bound the resolver accepts      everything, exactly as before, so the deployment sequence      (deploy resolver → register schema → bind) is unchanged apart from the last step.      `TrustgraphsFactory` does all three in one transaction, leaving no unbound window.

bindSnapshot(address).details: A post-deploy call rather than a constructor argument because of the deployment      cycle: the snapshot's constructor takes the accumulator, so the accumulator must      exist first. Same shape as the contributions `TrustAccumulatorMirror.bindSnapshot`.      The `accumulator()` read-back is defence in depth: it turns a mistyped binding — the      one irreversible mistake available here — into a revert. It also fixes the ordering      when an instance rotates its input lane: deploy the new accumulator, call the      snapshot's constitutional `setAccumulator`, THEN bind.

checkpoint().details: Only the bound snapshot may mint, so every checkpoint id lands on the contract-fixed      epoch boundary with both lanes frozen and its `paramsHash` pinned.

boundSchema().notice: The one schema this resolver accepts. Zero until bound.

checkpoint().notice: Freeze the current accumulator as a new checkpoint. Permissionless.

isPayable().notice: Checks if the resolver can be sent ETH.

leafCount().notice: The number of edges folded so far.

multiAttest((bytes32,bytes32,uint64,uint.notice: Processes multiple attestations and verifies whether they are valid.

multiRevoke((bytes32,bytes32,uint64,uint.notice: Processes revocation of multiple attestation and verifies they can be revoked.

revoke((bytes32,bytes32,uint64,uint64,ui.notice: Processes an attestation revocation and verifies if it can be revoked.

snapshot().notice: The only address allowed to mint checkpoints: the `MerkleSnapshot` whose         `trigger()` freezes this lane. Set once, via `bindSnapshot`.

version().notice: Returns the full semver contract version.
